summary: Strategy Inc filed an 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 to announce routine dividend declarations on its preferred stock series (STRF, STRC, STRK, STRD) and maintain the 12.00% dividend rate on its Variable Rate Series A Perpetual Stretch Preferred Stock. The board declared quarterly and semi-monthly cash dividends payable on September 30 and October 15, 2026, to stockholders of record as of specified dates. This is a standard dividend maintenance and declaration event, not a special-situation transaction. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, restructuring, or other strategic event is involved. Routine preferred dividend disclosures do not constitute a special situation; the filing is merely a current report on ordinary capital return mechanics.
